root cause candidate: checkout (75%): Revision 2 config release changed PAYMENT_ADDR from payment:8080 to payment:9999. Checkout's Charge calls dial a port that is not serving, so every payment charge times out and PlaceOrder fails.

root cause candidate: checkout (90%): Config release revision 2 (19:23:33Z) set CART_ADDR to cart:9999 instead of cart:8080. Checkout's gRPC dials to cart time out, so GetCart and PlaceOrder fail for every order. Roll back checkout to revision 1 or correct CART_ADDR.

root cause candidate: checkout (93%): Config release 'cart client moved to port 9999' (revision 2) set CART_ADDR=cart:9999. Cart does not listen on that port, so every GetCart call from checkout times out on dial and PlaceOrder fails.
